items.title: Finiteness of the cohomology of tori and of finite multiplicative-type group schemes over a curve
items.author: Cyril Demarche; David Harari
items.work: Duality for complexes of tori over a global field of positive characteristic
items.source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 7 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.129
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is about a curve U over a global field of positive characteristic: it claims that for a torus T the groups H^0(U, T) and H^1(U, T) are of finite type (finite when U is not X), and that for a finite group scheme N of multiplicative type both H^1(U, N) and H^2_c(U, N^D) are finite (statement lines 561-573). The proof splits T along a finite connected etale Galois covering, uses Dirichlet's theorem and the finiteness of the ideal class group to bound the two cohomology groups, and then embeds N into a sequence of two tori so that the finiteness reduces to an image computation plus a division by the order of N (proof lines 578-621). The step that is not a routine citation is the second one: the connecting map H^0(U, T_2) -> H^1(U, N) has to be controlled by factoring it through H^0(U, T_2)/n, and the author supplies that factorisation explicitly rather than invoking a general finiteness principle. The duality input at the end is a cited theorem, so the card is H2.
